params.topic: MLS 2021-2025 historical football 1X2 odds gap recovery
questions: For USA MLS regular-season matches from 2021 through 2025, find public, verifiable historical 1X2 odds pages or datasets that provide opening and closing/pre-match odds for Pinnacle and William Hill.

Prioritize rows that can be matched by season, kickoff date, home team, and away team. Return a structured JSON list with season, kickoff, home_team, away_team, bookmaker, opening_home, opening_draw, opening_away, closing_home, closing_draw, closing_away, source_url, and evidence_notes.

Keep Pinnacle and William Hill separate. Do not infer missing odds, do not convert closing odds into opening odds, and do not merge ambiguous team/date matches. For every unavailable or ambiguous row, report unavailable or blocked with the reason rather than guessing.
Focus on historical MLS rows that can supplement a local 2021-2025 fixture inventory and explicitly state coverage counts, unmatched counts, duplicate/conflict counts, and source semantics.
